findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_printability, analyze_model, get_print_quote, compare_printers · Private data: check_printability, optimize_orientation, analyze_model, get_print_quote, slice_model, compare_printers, recommend_material, recommend_settings, whatif_infill, scale_advisor, validate_model, cost_breakdown, analyze_3d_model · Public sink: check_printability, optimize_orientation, analyze_model, get_print_quote, slice_model, compare_printers, recommend_material, recommend_settings, whatif_infill, scale_advisor, validate_model, cost_breakdown, analyze_3d_model · Destructive: slice_model.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_printability, analyze_model, get_print_quote, compare_printers · Private data: check_printability, optimize_orientation, analyze_model, get_print_quote, slice_model, compare_printers, recommend_material, recommend_settings, whatif_infill, scale_advisor, validate_model, cost_breakdown, analyze_3d_model · Public sink: check_printability, optimize_orientation, analyze_model, get_print_quote, slice_model, compare_printers, recommend_material, recommend_settings, whatif_infill, scale_advisor, validate_model, cost_breakdown, analyze_3d_model · Destructive: slice_model

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
